name: hx-effectiveness-ntu
source:
// Heat Exchanger — Effectiveness-NTU Method
{ Counterflow water-to-water exchanger rated with the effectiveness-NTU method. }
mdot_h = 2.0 [kg/s]
cp_h = 4180 [J/kg-K]
mdot_c = 1.5 [kg/s]
cp_c = 4180 [J/kg-K]
Th_in = 360 [K]
Tc_in = 290 [K]
UA = 12000 [W/K]

C_h = mdot_h * cp_h
C_c = mdot_c * cp_c
C_min = min(C_h, C_c)
C_max = max(C_h, C_c)
Cr = C_min / C_max
NTU = UA / C_min

eps = hx_effectiveness('counterflow', NTU, Cr)
Q_max = C_min * (Th_in - Tc_in)
Q = eps * Q_max
Th_out = Th_in - Q / C_h
Tc_out = Tc_in + Q / C_c
dTlm = LMTD(Th_in - Tc_out, Th_out - Tc_in)
